# gpui-pre-windows 0.3.12

This copy of the GPUI Windows backend is based on the gpui-pre-windows 0.3.12
source package on crates.io and licensed under [Apache-2.0](LICENSE-APACHE).

The fuzukue contributors modified the manifest and lockfile and patched
DirectWrite text handling and Windows event, platform, and window code.
The Microsoft attribution in src/alpha_correction.hlsl is preserved.
